page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6e.26xlarge is an enterprise bare-metal instance from the ECS Bare Metal family, designed for high-concurrency enterprise workloads. Built on the 64-bit x86 architecture, the system provides 104 dedicated physical or logical processing cores. Because it deploys as a bare-metal resource through a lightweight KVM-assisted management infrastructure, tenant workloads run with direct access to processor resources, eliminating virtualization overhead and core contention.

System memory totals 384.0 GB, yielding a memory allocation ratio of approximately 3.69 GB per core. The server does not contain integrated local storage disks, necessitating reliance on networked block storage for all operational and persistence requirements. Network capabilities include a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth configuration, supporting high-throughput interconnectivity for distributed environments. The hardware profile features no dedicated GPUs and does not allocate default complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance consolidates substantial compute capacity into a single dedicated node, maximizing resource utilization efficiency for multi-threaded systems. Workload fit includes high-traffic web applications, large distributed container clusters, continuous integration and build nodes, batch processing tasks, and backend database servers utilizing external enterprise network storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6e.26xlarge is a bare-metal instance within the ECS Bare Metal family, engineered for enterprise deployments requiring dedicated execution environments. Based on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. This configuration establishes a balanced compute-to-memory profile suited for general-purpose workloads and compute-intensive operations. The instance includes a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface to manage high-throughput inter-node traffic, while operating without discrete graphics processing hardware or bundled local storage. Consequently, persistent storage must be attached via network-attached block devices. With its high core density and dedicated resource model, the instance removes hypervisor contention, making it appropriate for container orchestration clusters, large-scale web application serving, backend enterprise databases, and continuous integration pipelines.
